प्रबन्ध् प्र-बन्ध्, cl. 9. P. -बध्नाति,
-बन्द्धुम्, to bind on, bind, fasten, connect; to
suppress, check, stop.

प्र-बद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, bound on, bound, fas-
tened, fettered; connected; suppressed, checked,
stopped.
—प्रबद्ध-मूत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, suffering
from retention of urine or ischury.

प्र-बन्द्धृ, धा, m. one who connects toge-
ther, an author.

प्र-बन्ध, अस्, m. a connection, a bond, tie,
(गर्भ-नाडी-प्रबन्ध, the umbilical cord); an
uninterrupted connection, continuous series; uninter-
ruptedness, continuance, continuous application or
action; a continued discourse or narration, connected
discussion or narrative; a composition, any literary
composition, especially a poetical production.
—प्र-
बन्ध-कल्पना, f. a feigned story, a work of
imagination (whether founded on fact or not).
—प्र-
बन्ध-वर्ष, अस्, m. incessant rain, rain without
intermission.
—प्रबन्धाध्याय (˚ध-अध्˚),
अस्, m., N. of the fourth chapter of the Saṅgīta-
darpaṇa; of the fourth book of the Saṅgīta-ratnākara.
प्राबन्ध प्राबन्ध in केसर-प्राबन्धा, q. v.

प्र-बन्धन, अम्, n. connection, bond, tie;
[cf. सन्धि-प्˚.]
प्रबभ्र प्र-बभ्र, अस्, m. an epithet of Indra.

प्रबर्ह प्र-बर्ह or प्र-वर्ह, अस्, आ, अम्
(fr. rt. बृह् or वृह् with प्र), the best, most
excellent.

प्रबल 1. प्र-बल, अस्, आ, अम् (see बल),
prevailing, predominant; strong, powerful, mighty,
great; violent (as pain); important, significant;
abounding with; dangerous, pernicious; (अस्), m.,
N. of an attendant of Viṣṇu; of a Daitya; a sprout,
shoot (= प्र-बाल); (आ), f. a kind of plant (=
प्र-सारिणी); (अम्), ind. strongly, exceedingly,
much.
—प्रबल-ता, f. or प्रबल-त्व, अम्, n.
strength, power, might, mightiness, validity.
—प्र-
बल-तोय, अस्, आ, अम्, abounding in water.
—प्र-
बल-रुदित, अम्, n. strong crying, excessive weeping.
—प्रबल-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, strong, mighty.

2. प्रबल, Nom. P. प्रबलति, &c., to become
strong or powerful.

प्र-बाल, अस्, अम्, m. n. (sometimes spelt प्र-
वाल), a young shoot, sprout, new leaf or branch;
coral (in this sense also written प्र-वाड); the
neck of the Indian lute; (अस्), m. an animal; a
pupil; a kind of vegetable; [cf. प्रबालिक.]
—प्र-
बाल-पद्म, अम्, n. a red lotus-flower.
—प्रबाल-
फल, अम्, n. red sandal-wood.
—प्रबाल-भस्मन्,
अ, n. calx or ashes of coral (used medicinally).
—प्र-
बाल-मणि-शृङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, having horns of
coral and gems.
—प्रबाल-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having
new leaves or shoots.
—प्रबालाश्मन्तक (˚ल-
अश्˚), (probably) coral.

प्रबाल प्र-बाल. See under 1. प्र-बल,
col. 1.

प्रबालक, अस्, m., N. of a Yakṣa; (इका), f.,
N. of a female.
प्रबालिक, अस्, m. a kind of vegetable.

प्राबालिक प्राबालिक, अस्, m. (fr. प्र-बाल),
a vender of coral, coral merchant.

प्रबली प्रबली, f. a class, division of a
community, (supposed to be used in this sense in a
particular inscription.)

प्रबह्लिका प्रबह्लिका = प्रवह्लिका or प्र-
वल्हिका, q. v.

प्रबाध् प्र-बाध्, cl. 1. A. -बाधते, -बा-
धितुम्, to press forwards, drive; to press hard upon,
pain, torment, oppress, disquiet, vex, annoy; to
throw down, destroy, demolish, abolish, unmake;
to press back, drive back, repel, repulse.

प्र-बाधक, अस्, इका, अम्, pressing back, keeping
off, keeping back, keeping at a distance; refusing.

प्र-बाधन, अम्, n. pressing hard upon, op-
pressing, tormenting, paining; keeping off, keeping
back, keeping at a distance; refusing, denying.

प्र-बाधमान, अस्, आ, अम्, pressing hard upon,
tormenting, afflicting, paining; keeping off, keeping
back.

प्र-बाधित, अस्, आ, अम्, pressed forwards, driven;
oppressed.

प्र-बाबधान, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Intens.), Ved.
hastening on before, overtaking.

प्रबाहु प्र-बाहु, उस्, m. the fore-arm;
‘long-armed,’ N. of a man.
प्रबाहुक, अस्, m. ‘long-armed,’ N. of a man.

प्रबाहुक् प्र-बाहुक्, ind., Ved. in an even
line, in an equal series, on an equal height, on a
level; at the same time.
प्र-बाहुकम्, ind. at the same time; on high.

प्रबुध् 1. प्र-बुध्, cl. 4. A. -बुध्यते,
-बोधितुम्, to wake up, wake, awaken (intrans.);
to bloom, blossom; cl. 1. P. -बोधति, to wake up,
wake, awake (trans.); to become sensible or aware of,
perceive, observe, regard: Caus. -बोधयति, -यितुम्,
to wake up, wake, awaken (trans.); to make sen-
sible, cause to know, inform, admonish; to try to
convince, persuade; to instruct, teach (with two acc.);
to explain; to cause to expand or bloom; to stimu-
late (by gentle friction).

2. प्र-बुध्, भुत्, त्, त्, Ved. attentive, watching
for; (त्), f. awaking.

प्र-बुद्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, awakened, wakened,
awake, roused; enlivened, lively; clear-sighted, clever,
wise, learned; expanded, blown, in bloom; unfolded,
developed; beginning to take effect (as a spell); (अस्),
m., N. of a teacher.
—प्रबुद्ध-ता, f. intelli-
gence, wisdom (opposed to जड-ता).
प्र-बुध, अस्, m. a great sage.

प्र-बोध, अस्, m. awaking (either from sleep or
from ignorance); awakening, becoming conscious,
consciousness; blowing (as of a flower); vigilance,
watchfulness, wakefulness, activity; intellect, under-
standing, knowledge, wisdom, intelligence; explain-
ing; consoling, consolation; reviving the fragrance
of a perfume which has lost its scent.
—प्रबोध-
चन्द्र, अस्, m. the moon of knowledge, i. e. Know-
ledge personified and compared to the moon.
—प्र-
बोध-चन्द्रिका, f. ‘moonlight of knowledge,’ N.
of a grammar by Vaijana.
—प्रबोध-चन्द्रोदय
(˚र-उद्˚), अस्, m. ‘rise of the moon of knowledge,’
Intelligence personified and compared to the risen
moon; N. of a celebrated philosophical drama.
—प्र-
बोध-प्रकाश, अस्, m., N. of a grammar.
—प्र-
बोध-सिद्धि, इस्, f., N. of a work.
—प्रबोध-
सुधाकर, अस्, m., N. of a Vedānta work.
—प्र-
बोधोत्सव (˚ध-उत्˚), अस्, m. ‘waking-festival,’
a festival observed from the tenth to the day of full
moon of the month Kārttika; see प्र-बोधिनी.
—प्रबोधोदय (˚ध-उद्˚), अस्, m. ‘the rise of
knowledge,’ N. of a work; [cf. प्रबोध-चन्द्रो-
दय.]

प्राबोधक प्राबोधक, अस्, m. (= प्र-बो-
धक), a minstrel employed to wake the king in
the morning; (a various reading for प्राबोधिक.)

प्र-बोधन, अस्, ई, अम्, awakening, exciting,
arousing; (अस्), m., N. of a Buddha; (ई), f. the
eleventh day in the light half of the month Kārttika
celebrated as a festival in commemoration of the wak-
ing of Viṣṇu; the plant Alhagi Maurorum (= दुर्-
आलभा); (अम्), n. waking, awaking (e. g. कल्य-
प्रबोधन, waking at day-break); awakening,
arousing, exciting, reviving; knowledge, understand-
ing; instructing, informing, explaining; reviving the
fragrance of a perfume which has lost its scent.

प्र-बोधित, अस्, आ, अम्, awakened, wakened,
awake, aroused, roused; taught, instructed, informed,
[]
admonished; convinced, persuaded; (आ), f. a kind of
metre, four times ˘˘¯˘¯˘˘˘¯˘¯˘¯.
—प्र-
बोधित-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has awaked.

प्र-बोधिन्, ई, इनी, इ, waking, awaking; (इनी), f.
the eleventh day in the light half of the month Kārt-
tika celebrated as a festival in commemoration of the
waking of Viṣṇu; [cf. प्र-बोधनी.]
—प्रबोधि-
ता, f. the being (early) awake, waking betimes.
1. प्र-बोध्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be awakened.

2. प्र-बोध्य, ind. having awakened; having
instructed, having explained; having apologized.

प्रब्रू प्र-ब्रू, cl. 2. P. A. -ब्रवीति, -ब्रूते,
&c., to speak before (with acc.); to proclaim, an-
nounce, publish, declare, inform; to celebrate, praise,
laud, glorify (Ved.); to read before (with gen. or
dat.); to recite, teach; to tell (with two acc.); to
exclaim, shout; to describe; सत्यम् प्र-ब्रू, to
speak the truth, speak sincerely.

प्राबल्य प्राबल्य, अम्, n. (fr. प्र-बल),
superiority of force, superior force, predominance, as-
cendancy; powerfulness, power, vigour, might, force.

प्राबोधिक, अस्, m. (fr. प्र-बोध), dawn, day-
break.
